title: Zoho Desk Blended Agents: Free AI Agents With Human Handover (Nov 2026)
headline: Zoho Desk *AI agents*
source_line: Source: Zoho press release via Business Wire, 16 Nov 2026; ANI / The Tribune

sources.name: Zoho press release (Business Wire via Yahoo Finance, 16 Nov 2026)

description:
Zoho announced Blended Agents for Zoho Desk on 16 Nov 2026. Built on Zia Agents, they retrieve order details, check stock and update customer accounts in connected apps, then hand a case to a human with the full history when it needs judgment; agents can be paused so a person reviews or approves an action. Building and deploying agents costs nothing extra on all paid Zoho Desk plans - you pay only for LLM usage. Zoho-hosted models come with a monthly allowance of up to 30 million free tokens depending on the plan, or you can bring your own API key. Available in India, the US, the EU, Japan, China and Australia (Canada coming soon).

Sources (checked 17 Nov 2026):
- Zoho press release (Business Wire via Yahoo Finance, 16 Nov 2026): https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/zoho-introduces-blended-agents-zoho-110000606.html
- The Tribune (ANI, 16 Nov 2026): https://tribuneindia.com/news/business/zoho-launches-blended-ai-agents-to-automate-customer-service-with-human-oversight
- Zoho press releases: https://www.zoho.com/press.html

This video uses an AI-generated presenter, voice and animations; facts were checked against the sources above.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation.

beats.text: Zoho introduces Blended Agents in Zoho Desk
A human takes the hard cases

lines: Zoho Desk now has Blended Agents: A I agents that do the routine support work, and hand the hard cases to a person.
They run on Zia Agents, and can look up order details, check stock and update customer accounts.
When a case needs judgment, the agent passes the chat to your team with the full history. You can also pause it and approve an action first.
